title: ContextMint | AI Writes Code. We Decide What Can Ship.
description: ContextMint is a local-first AI decision-control plane — evidence before inference, human approval before repo changes. v1.0 ships end of August 2026.

hero.subAfter: for software teams — not generic chat. Review retrieved evidence before the model answers. Approve patches before anything applies. Code stays on your infrastructure by default.

finalCta.title: Govern AI velocity without silent applies
finalCta.line1: The question is no longer whether AI writes your code.
finalCta.line2: It is whether humans see evidence before it ships.

pilotNow.title: In pilot now
pilotNow.introRest: We are finishing internal pilot readiness; design partner intake opens by start of September 2026. Evidence before inference. Human approval before code changes.

cards.title: ContextMint Engine
cards.text: Tray-native operator console — readiness, server, and Ollama status. System, Light, or Dark theme.

cards.title: Context Lens
cards.text: Review what will be retrieved and which model runs — before the model answers.

cards.title: Quality map
cards.text: Stored governance findings (duplicates, structure signals) with human apply gates.

cards.title: Image evidence
cards.text: Paste UI screenshots — local Ollama vision and ARGUS visual audit with human gates.

footer.sharedServerText: Shared on-prem API server path for regulated pilots —
footer.byokText: Optional BYOK cloud routing is off by default.

items.label: Local-first
items.text: Index and chat on your infrastructure

problem.title: The Problem Isn't Code Generation. It's Trust.
problem.lead: AI creates changes faster than organizations can review them with evidence. That is a board-level risk — not a tooling gap.

cards.title: AI Creates
cards.text: Changes faster than humans can reason about them

cards.title: Reality is Fragmented
cards.text: Ownership, intent, and policy live in different tools

cards.title: Result
cards.text: Risky merges and ungoverned agent output

whyNow.title: The Bottleneck Moved
whyNow.lead: Code generation is no longer the constraint. Evidence and human oversight are.

before.label: Before AI
before.body: Humans generated code slower than organizations could review it.

after.label: After AI
after.body: AI generates code faster than organizations can verify with evidence.

decisionControl.title: What v1.0 delivers
decisionControl.lead: Evidence-based generative chat, store-first governance lookup from the quality map, and grounded recommendations with human approval — on your machine or a guided sovereign server path.

checks.text: Context Lens — retrieved chunks, scores, routing
Citations — answers grounded in indexed excerpts
High-severity apply — blocked until human review
Patch preview — unified diff before anything writes

whyNotCi.lead: Linting and tests catch syntax. They don't give developers evidence gates in the IDE.
